name: crabrave
description: TypeScript with Rust-style enums, match and ?: language server and syntax for .crab files

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The crabrave language server runs the content mapper from the project's node_modules.

crabrave.typescript.path.markdownDescription: Path to a TypeScript 7.1+ package (the folder containing its `package.json`). By default the extension looks for `node_modules/typescript` next to each `.crab` file and in its parent folders.

crabrave.typescriptFiles.markdownDescription: Also use the crabrave language server for `.ts`/`.tsx`/`.js` files in projects that contain `.crab` files, so they can import `.crab` modules. Turn off VS Code's built-in TypeScript features for those files to avoid duplicate results.

crabrave.trace.server.description: Log the messages between VS Code and the language server.

scripts.build: bun build src/extension.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --external vscode --sourcemap=linked
scripts.build:test: bun build test/suite/index.ts --outdir dist/test --target node --format cjs --external vscode
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run build:test && node test/run.mjs
scripts.package: bun run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license -o crabrave.vsix
